snippet.title: Slice of Life - Release Date Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
What Will We Do Today? Step into the shoes of Drake Lacasse as he starts a new life at Rosegate University. Make new friends, compete on the court, and search for answers in Slice of Life.

Dive into the winding story mode, or hit the court with a friend for some exhibitions or crazy side-games!

~smallrave.com~

Coming to Nintendo eShop on 10/8/2021
#NintendoSwitch #SOL #SliceOfLife #Indie
